name: Baserow

env.desc: The hostname you will reach this on, e.g. base.example.com
Email for the TLS certificate. Let's Encrypt uses it for expiry warnings.
Signs sessions. Changing it logs everyone out.
Encrypts every backup before it leaves the machine. Store it somewhere that is NOT this server — without it the backups are unreadable.
rclone remote and path for offsite backups, e.g. b2:my-bucket/baserow

restore_assertions.label: core Django tables restored
restore_assertions.sql: select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema='public'

restore_assertions.label: at least one user account survived

notes: Baserow ships an all-in-one image that bundles Postgres and Redis. This kit deliberately runs them as separate services, because a bundled database is far harder to back up and restore cleanly.
The first boot runs migrations and can take several minutes. That is normal.
